notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEZq1GlYD7I

Meowdy! After a lot of work and effort, the demo version of Cats on Broombas is finally out! This is a huge milestone for me, as this has been my passion project for a while now, and I hope it shows. Huge thanks to early testers and of course the little voice-over star who really brought this game to life!

The demo features [b]40 puzzles[/b] as well as a [b]level editor[/b] for making your own puzzles.

Please try it out, leave a review and share it with your friends who may like puzzles, cats or wholesome vibes.

On to finishing the full game now which will be much bigger, more challening and with a lot more features!
